description: This Java class 'SelfShareAccountsDataValidator' is responsible for validating JSON input data for share account applications within the Apache Fineract platform. It primarily verifies the presence and validity of the client's ID in the JSON payload and throws appropriate exceptions if validation fails.

classes.name: SelfShareAccountsDataValidator
classes.description: A Spring-managed component that validates JSON input data for share account application requests by ensuring required fields are present and correctly formatted.

methods.name: SelfShareAccountsDataValidator
methods.description: Constructor that injects the FromJsonHelper dependency.

methods.name: validateShareAccountApplication
methods.description: Validates the JSON string for required fields, especially 'clientId', ensuring it's a positive long, and returns the parsed client ID as a HashMap.
